planning_objective: actual simulated payload; then minimum radial action norm; then stable Round-15 candidate order
safe_projection: unchanged existing radial action projection and environment boundary processing
causal_transition: service at current buoy positions; then predict next buoy positions from current velocity and deterministic reflection. No future drift trace is read.
arrival_assumption: same Round-15 configuration-derived expected arrival; no realized future arrival trace is read by causal planning
buoy_boundary: reflection at [buoy_margin, area_extent-buoy_margin] on each axis, including repeated crossings; reflected velocity has its corresponding sign reversed
